title: Deeper/broader AC1024 BLOCKLOOKUPACTION peer-sequence crosswalk and semantic boundary
mode: Authoritative local specification search, current open-source reader/writer source crosswalk, public behavior-document review, and plan readiness update
scope: Revisit PAR-133 candidate DWG field shape and distinguish normative byte-layout evidence from peer implementation evidence.
Check whether the dynamic-block lookup-action candidate can be confused with 3D geometry support claims.
Refine the next implementation slice without changing parsing, executing external programs, or adding fixtures.

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 local reference copy
sources.method: pdftotext -layout; case-insensitive search for BLOCKLOOKUPACTION, BlockLookupAction, dynamic blocks, lookup actions, and lookup tables
sources.observed: The text extraction search returned no class-specific dynamic-block lookup-action layout.
sources.limits: Search absence is not proof that no relevant generic object/custom-class rule or cross-reference exists. ODA remains authoritative.

sources.name: ACadSharp current DWG object reader
sources.observed: readBlockLookupAction reads the common action, row and column BitLongs, rows-times-columns variable text, one column record per column, then a bit. Each column candidate has three BitLongs, a bit, variable text, a bit, and variable text.
sources.limits: Mutable peer implementation; not normative evidence or an independently captured producer layout.

sources.name: ACadSharp current DXF object writer
sources.observed: writeBlockLookupAction emits row and column counts, row-major group-302 values, then per-column 94/95/96/282/305/281/304 fields and group 280.
sources.limits: Same implementation family as the DWG reader; useful internal model/read-write consistency only, not an independent DWG wire-order witness.

sources.name: LibreDWG 0.13.4 OBJECTS manual
sources.observed: The field inventory separates numrows, numcols, lut records, exprs as variable text, and B280.
sources.limits: Does not specify exact serialized ordering, per-version bit/string stream boundaries, or full round-trip behavior.

sources.name: LibreDWG current object stability registry and NEWS
sources.observed: BLOCKLOOKUPACTION is marked UNSTABLE; NEWS states unstable objects are not preserved through DXF conversion.
sources.limits: Mutable project status, not a DWG specification or semantic validation of this local record.

sources.name: Autodesk Block Editor help
sources.observed: Describes the user-level lookup action/table relationship to dynamic block parameters.
sources.limits: Behavioral documentation; no serialized field order or local drawing expectation.

sources.name: Local libdxfrw PAR-133 trace and source
sources.observed: The local AC1024 sample identifies class 528/handle 0x22F and the parser stops at a count preflight before consuming any expression/connection value. The previous receipt records a partial run, object/data/handle boundary diagnostics, and no production field-order change.
sources.limits: The sample provenance is not independently verified; the whole conversion is partial and has an unrelated Classes CRC mismatch; preflight rejection does not prove the peer layout.

assessment.candidateLocalIssue: A likely mismatch exists between the local per-cell expression-plus-three-connections parser shape and the ACadSharp rows-times-columns text array plus per-column model; exact DWG layout remains unproven.
assessment.semanticCategory: Dynamic/parametric block action metadata, separate from explicit 3D entities, ACIS/SAB payload decoding, and B-rep semantics.
assessment.decision: Preserve fail-closed production behavior. Run a cursor-only candidate probe over independent data/string buffers and the declared handle boundary. Require complete bounded decoding plus authoritative or second-producer confirmation before changing parse order.

planChanges: Record the current ACadSharp DWG reader and DXF writer sequence while explicitly treating their within-project agreement as non-independent evidence.
Record LibreDWG's independent field inventory and unstable/non-preserving status without promoting it to a round-trip oracle.
Separate dynamic-block action parsing/evaluation claims from the plan's 3D geometry and ACIS/ACDS support claims.

Refine PAR-133's next step to a non-publishing probe over data, string, and handle stream bounds, followed only after field-order proof by generated non-square, truncation, resource-cap, and sentinel controls.
Flag inconsistent historical 141/142 finding totals without selecting a canonical count or silently rewriting past receipts.
limitations: No DWG field-order change was made because the local ODA specification search and public peer sources do not independently prove the local record's exact serialized order.
No external reader, CAD application, or converter was executed.
No external DWG/DXF sample was downloaded, committed, or used as a fixture.
No count reconciliation or support promotion was performed; J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
